jumped ok. Settled Down Inside 6th 5 Lengths @ 700m. off rail home Turn . Hooked Out all Clear Straightening Up . Just a bit Tight past 200m but generally Clear , finished off ok not Beaten far # ran on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hung in under pressure during the straight and near the 200m was steadied after shifting in towards heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped fairly. Pushed fwd & raced 4th on rail (2.5L from lead) early . Tracked leader on inside midrace & pushed to quicken on inside (1L from lead) on home turn. Pushed to challenge leaders & pressured @ 250m. Gave ground on rail in last 150m. blinkers off first time. Vetted slow recovery. # didn't finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Jockey reported mount travelled well throughout, however, when placed under pressure in the straight, it was inclined to hang in & did not finish the race off strongly. He added that the running along the rail in the home straight was inferior & that his mount was unsuited by racing in this section of the track. Post-race vet revealed a slow recovery rate. Trainer reported no abnormalities with recovery the following day & added that, as the gelding was resuming, it would benefit from being stepped out in trip as prep continues. Added would exp with gear to address hanging in.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out 1 length sat rail 4l off, limited room turn, Straightened Up 3l off, found little and plodded home # poor/issue??
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Jockey reported that after beginning only fairly, he rode his mount along from the inside barrier to maintain a midfield position. He said that approaching the home turn, he attempted to angle his mount out but became awkwardly placed on heels and subsequently checked his mount. He said that he then shifted mount back to the inside on straightening, whereby the gelding was inclined to lay in and was disappointing in the run to the line. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities. Trainer advised that the gelding would be sent to spell.
